verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the forest background is a narrow centre strip, the white headline sits on the white canvas and can't be seen (only stray 'd' and 'y' glyphs show), and the subline, quote and URL are clipped at the strip edges, with divider lines floating at the bottom. B is just the portrait original shrunk into the middle of the banner, with large empty white areas on both sides. Its headline runs past the strip ('Devoted', 'Day' clipped), the body text is too small to read, and the divider lines have broken off to the far right, but at least it still reads as the same design.
